text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay! That does it for morning practice!
I've
gotta head to my test...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's wrong or anything. I'm a whole
different
me today, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Jordan. If we don't start studying,
we'll have
to take extra classes...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I hope you're ready. We're going all out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, are you okay, City? This isn't like
you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! First up is classical literature!
Write the
correct word in each bracket!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, okay... An axe for cutting bamboo...
Umm...
tomahawk?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look at the word bank. There's no
tomahawk
there, is there?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, like... What's really going on with
you?
Why are you suddenly so serious?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You realize you've changed, right?
You've been
taking your training
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So I was just thinking... it'd be a shame if
you had
to waste time on taking
make-up classes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: City... Are you trying to be... hunky?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I'll do it! I'll take it so seriously this time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All right, then. Look at the word bank
page I
mentioned before.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here it is. I didn't realize this page
was there.
But yikes, there's a bunch of
stuff listed. Like, kill
me now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You need to memorize all of that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...For real?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, since City has been training me so
seriously,
there's, like, no way I can mess
this up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to go slay! Here I come, test!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Jordan's exam scores still on my
mind, I go
to grab some food, when who
should appear but
exactly the person I'm
thinking of.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sorry. Were you waiting long?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There you are. Okay, time for my big

announcement!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Good timing, Trainer. You should hear
this too.
Here goes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hold my breath as I wait to hear how it
went.
And...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I got a fourteen!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey! That's... That's...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Double your last score!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thank you sooo much, City!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That axe thing you taught me was on the
test too.
I was the first one finished!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right? Now you can aim even higher
next time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's fine! This is huge progress for her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not like she can change completely
all at
once. Any improvement is good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I usually have no clue what's going
on, but I
felt like I understood at least a
few things this
time! And it's all thanks
to City!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Gold City's help, Tosen Jordan was
able to
really try hard on her test. If
there's one thing I
can tell her now, it's...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Gold City's help, Tosen Jordan was
able to
really try hard on her test. If
there's one thing I
can tell her now, it's...
choice_data_list: 早く解けたのはいいな
早く解けたのはいいね

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, what? You mean right now?
choice_data_list: 早く解けたのはいいな
早く解けたのはいいね

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's more effective if you review while the

questions are fresh in your mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How about this? If you can avoid getting
extra
classes, I'll take you shopping.
What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on! No fair!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Okay, fine! I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, since you're all worried about
me, I've
gotta work hard on the review
too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Listen, City! I'm gonna do even better
next time!
Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you will. I can't wait to see what
you can
do.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! No one can answer faster
than me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Teachers always say to check your
answers if you
have time left, right? But I
never change any! It's
just like extra free
time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The only thing left is to catch my
accuracy up
with my speed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: At any rate, it's progress!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!
